## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] New or changed logic has unit tests; flows across processes have an e2e spec when it makes sense
- [ ] Every new UI string is in both `en.json` and `id.json`
- [ ] The UI matches the mockups in `docs/ui` (or the difference is explained above)
- [ ] The commit messages follow Conventional Commits and carry no attribution lines
- [ ] The change adds no source, repository or key to the app
